metadata.scope: Phase 0 / U-004 seventh remediation and current-HEAD dynamic evidence

executiveSummary.text: Current-HEAD dynamic evidence independently verifies 7 of 7 suites and 33 of 33 tests with no failures. The Long-to-String runtime identity defect and the MinIO header evidence issue are closed. CHANGES_REQUESTED remains because the previous PASS-finalization Medium still permits artifact mutation after snapshot verification and before publication, and the previous containment Low remains open for POSIX evidence-root ancestors.

previousFindingClosure.finding: P00-R3-L2 MinIO headers bypass secret proof

detailedFindings.summary: A verified in-memory artifact snapshot can diverge from the disk bundle before PASS persistence and atomic publication.
POSIX opens the multi-component evidence root directly, so O_NOFOLLOW does not anchor earlier ancestor components.
